compared: No public item drawn from stacks-project:more-algebra.tex states this two-part uniqueness lemma. The 57 public items of that chapter were resolved by their recorded source line ranges and none of them covers original lines 144-171; public 304 (tag 07VE, original lines 194-245) is the Artin-Rees perturbation lemma of the same chapter and is a different statement, while public 336 (descent of projectivity through finite injective ring extensions) is about descent along ring extensions rather than detection of isomorphisms modulo a radical ideal.

Near neighbours on projective modules from the same chapter do different things: public 305 (original lines 806-889) proves flatness of a patched fibre-product module, public 353 (original lines 19389-19466) lifts a prescribed projective complex, and public 413 (controlled Ext factorizations for powers of an ideal) is about Ext annihilation. None of them proves that an R-module map of finite projectives which is an isomorphism modulo I is an isomorphism.

The sibling card DSH-alg-more-algebra-lift-stably-free counts the existence statement of the same section (lemma-lift-stably-free, original lines 92-111) and has no overlap with this two-part uniqueness statement: the two are consecutive author results of that section, are counted as separate cards, and neither proof uses the other. The sentence referring to lemma-lift-stably-free printed at source line 141 is deliberately left outside both counted spans.

The pool card for this source lists lemma-isomorphic-finite-projective-lifts as its fourth candidate; all twelve of its candidates were checked line by line against the statement spans of every task card under focused-seeds, and none of them is claimed by any card; the preparation worklist has no row whose claim_key names more-algebra.tex. reference/retired-claims.json holds no record from this chapter.
